title: modelcontextprotocol/servers
friendlyTitle: Official example servers for connecting AI to tools
summary: The official Model Context Protocol servers repository contains reference implementations that show how AI applications can connect to tools and data through MCP. The actively maintained project has more than 90,000 GitHub stars.
friendlySummary: This popular repository shows how AI applications can use the Model Context Protocol to connect with data and software tools.
whyItMatters: Developers can use the reference servers to learn MCP patterns, test clients and prototype controlled tool access. Production users should review permissions and security boundaries rather than treating examples as ready-made infrastructure.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It is a useful starting point for learning and prototypes. Review security and permissions carefully before using an example in production.
